messages:
nina: Hey team — PR #3789 preview failed. Linkcheck + vale + md-lint. Need someone to help triage quickly before the midday docs push.
aldo: can you paste the CI snippet/errors?
nina: linkcheck: "http://internal-service/setup" -> 404 (internal link). md-lint: MD022 (headings should be surrounded by blank lines) on the migration doc. vale: flagged passive voice and a couple of long sentences.
ci-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #3789 — linkcheck: 1 error, markdown-lint: 1 error, vale: 2 warnings. Logs: https://ci.redwood/preview/3789
tara: for internal links we usually swap to the public mirror or add a short note like "internal-only" and include the public docs link. I can take a look.
aldo: i'll fix the heading spacing and break the long sentences. nina — do you want me to also change the internal link?
nina: yes please swap to https://docs.redwood.ai/setup-fallback. also try to remove passive voice: change "the migration can be run by users" -> "run the migration using the CLI".
ci-bot: nina triggered a re-run for PR #3789.
aldo: pushed commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3789/files — fixed heading spacing, rephrased the passive sentence, replaced link, and added ```bash to the code fence (untagged fences were causing highlight glitches).
ci-bot: Re-run results: linkcheck: PASS, markdown-lint: PASS, vale: WARN (1 minor suggestion: replace "utilise" -> "use"). Preview deploy: ✅
tara: nice. @aldo can you add a quick changelog note for the migration doc?
aldo: added changelog line in the PR.
nina: LGTM, thanks everyone. Merging now to hit the midday push. :rocket:
